notes: Imported from a box-office seat manifest: 157 rows, 1265 seats, 143 held (2-HOUS 30, 3-ARTI 30, 4-MKTG 30, 1-TECH 41, 5-ADA 12). Tiers are the manifest price levels (P1 $125, P2 $85, P3 $70, P4 $50, P5 $25); floors are those prices. RowRank is derived — price level, then row letter (AA before A), then section order — adjust with a rank file (section,row,rowRank) if the room disagrees. Lean is inward by section name; area is guessed from the section name.
